conditions.evidence: Parkinson Disease and Multiple System Atrophy
conditions.label: Multiple System Atrophy

modalities.evidence: modified Hoehn and Yahr scale (HY, PD severity)

output.population: 16 subjects enrolled; eight in the intranasal insulin group and six in the placebo group completed baseline and post-treatment assessments and were analysed.
output.summary: Data from a randomized, double-blinded, placebo-controlled trial of intranasal insulin versus saline over four weeks, assessing cognitive and motor performance with verbal fluency, UPDRS and Hoehn and Yahr measures.
